adaptations: Native extensions request generation-checked document reads through JSON-RPC completion messages. This preserves Hunk's observable asynchronous lease behavior without embedding a JavaScript runtime in the host.
Ratatui cells replace OpenTUI frames and Workdeck attribution replaces Hunk branding. File contents, consent state, refusal details, reload ownership, and extension results remain acceptance data.

The stable file differs only because WorkspaceFileWriter still lived in App.tsx before the baseline refactor moved it to useExtensionWorkspaceControls.ts; both source suites execute the same 13 behaviors.
